operations.text: The readiness cycle is leaner and sharper (LEAN-001). ONE AGENT: /pnp:review Step 2a dispatches one scan-tier agent per ticket that returns both the behavior ledger and the consequence scan - two tables, the two files unchanged (ledger.md and consequence-scan.md; the plan gate reads the second); the delta scan before a further pass is a dispatch of its own carrying the SCAN half. COUNTER PAIR: gone - a Pass statistics row records which pass it was and what it cost as the engine reported it, nothing asks the operator for a counter, and the one-live-auditor clause of WORKFLOW Branch policy, which held only while a pair was being recorded, is removed. CLASS 15: docs/READINESS_CLASSES.md - a race or lock decision a plan leaves as an 'accepted residual' is an open decision; the own pass names, for every write, the lock and what runs beside it (check 3, discovery). OWN PASS: it opens every pointer the Writer acts on, reads the ledger rows as behavior and runs every instrument with valid AND broken input - not 'every file:line opened'. POINTERS: a plan carries file:line where the Writer acts or acceptance reads, and cites context by section and symbol. PLANSDIR: the self-check observes a plansDir under the scratch directory (a note, never a failure) and /pnp:setup warns at the plans question - a lexical prefix test over the configured paths (case and backslashes fold on a project whose os is windows; git is not asked). YOUR LOCAL RULES: a local rule for any of these - one agent for ledger and scan, no counter pair, the concurrency class, the own-pass wording, the pointer discipline - can be removed or become a one-line pointer to /pnp:review Steps 2a-2d and docs/READINESS_CLASSES.md. YOUR TRANSFER SURFACE is yours and is not rewritten: its Pass statistics text stays as you have it and is yours to change; the template changes for new installations only.
